alt: Hallakgungi collapsed in white rags under a looming shadow
Sara crying over his collapsed son
Sara nursing Hallakgungi with a bowl
Hallakgungi recoils when he hears his mother is dead
Sara lays out the revenge and the resurrection flowers
Hallakgungi in the gray hood with one eye covered
The house laughs itself down around the one-eyed guest
The hall weeps, and the guest does not look away
The heart flower in his hand
The daughters tear the magistrate's robe
The court eats itself, shown only as silhouettes
Hallakgungi cries and embraces his mother
Bones fly together into a skeleton in ivory light
Crimson blood swirls into the skeleton
Vermilion light builds her flesh over the bone
She draws a first breath in pale gold air
Rose light, the winter rose, her eyes find him
Sara and Wongang walk arm in arm into the sunset
